status: The PU-12M's fighting compartment from the ČSLA manual's equipment plan and workplace drawings (csla_pu12_manual, the valka_pu12 scans) and a veteran's photographs (shilka_narod): five places (driver front left, squad leader front right, the operator, the battery commander and the radio operator on the bench across the middle facing forward), the equipment where the plan puts it.
notes: Written by tools/pu12m_cabin.py from tools/blender/pu12m_interior_trace.py and art/pu12m_interior/manifest.json: edit those and run it again, not this file. Body frame: metres, x right, y forward, z up, from the ground under the middle of the wheelbase (the exterior model's origin). Lamp sources use the source ids of data/procedures/pu12m.json. ceiling_m: the roof's lining (1.40 m over the floor), under which a crewman getting up for a low panel crouches.

walk.notes: The knee room between the bench and the boards in front of it (the IT-45, the map, the radio operator's sets, their faces at y = -0.27 to -0.47): a crewman gets up and moves along the bench. SAM3D estimate from the cabin layout.
The aisle between the operator's P and R units (their faces at x = -0.33 and 0.32). SAM3D estimate.
Between the driver's and the squad leader's seats. SAM3D estimate.

stations.label: Driver
stations.notes: Front left, at the wheel (csla_pu12_manual: the squad leader and driver drawing; the plan's seat at 548-648 x 512-602 px). The GAK and its converter behind him, the PVS-3 and the ŠČV input board on the side at his left. Eye 0.79 m above the cushion, 1.22 m above the floor (data/crew/body.json).

stations.label: Squad leader
stations.notes: Front right (the plan's seat at 543-648 x 338-462 px): the KP-4 and the VO telescope ahead, the IT-1 board, the PVS-2 and the DTP at his right, the GAK's panel and his R-123M (FuG-1) on the side behind them. Eye 0.79 m above the cushion, 1.22 m above the floor (data/crew/body.json).

stations.label: Battery commander
stations.notes: The bench's right place, at the IT-45 (csla_pu12_manual: the battery commander's workplace; rwd_mb3: "Platz des Kommandeurs/Operators"): the tube ahead, the ДХ keypad at its left, the ФР block at its right, the DT-2 marker on the desk, the IT-2M over the tube, the RTK-1, the ŠČK and the R-123M of the battery net (FuG-4) on the desk at his right, the R-407 behind him. The bench: the plan's three places across the compartment facing forward (1288-1385 x 338-600 px). Eye 0.79 m above the cushion, 1.22 m above the floor (data/crew/body.json).

stations.label: Operator-plotter
stations.notes: The bench's middle place, the plotter's (rwd_mb3: "Platz des Planzeichners"): the air-situation map ahead of him (the plan's item 24), the IT-45 at his right front. The ФР block is the commander's; the plotter's work is the map: he plots what the tube and the voice nets give. Eye 0.79 m above the cushion, 1.22 m above the floor (data/crew/body.json).

stations.label: Radio operator
stations.notes: The bench's left place: the R-111 with the R-123M (FuG-2) on top ahead of him, his table between, the power boards (ŠČR, VS-27) and the PVS-1 on the side at his left (csla_pu12_manual: the radio operator's workplace drawing). Eye 0.79 m above the cushion, 1.22 m above the floor (data/crew/body.json).

panels.label: Driver's panel
panels.notes: The BTR-60PB's dashboard under the windscreen (csla_pu12_manual, the squad leader and driver drawing: the wheel on a panel of instruments). The post's switches on it are SAM3D's.

panels.label: PVS-3 intercom box
panels.notes: On the face of PVS-3 intercom box (csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 29)).

panels.label: ŠČV input board
panels.notes: The input board (ЩВ; csla_pu12_manual item 32, valka_pu12): the 220 V supply's selector and the AB-1 set's cable. SAM3D: the set's own start is worked from here too (the set stands outside on the ground; the crewman walks to it).

panels.label: KP-4 coordinate and course plotter
panels.notes: The KP-4 (csla_pu12_manual item 2; valka_pu12): it draws the route on the map in its window (1:50 000 to 1:200 000, flak11). Its face is SAM3D's arrangement.

panels.label: GAK's control panel
panels.notes: On the face of GAK's control panel (csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 7)).

panels.label: DTP coordinate sensor
panels.notes: The DTP (csla_pu12_manual item 5): it puts the post's offset from a reference point into the telecode (flak11 PU12-0). The windows and knobs are SAM3D's.

panels.label: PVS-2 intercom box
panels.notes: On the face of PVS-2 intercom box (csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 6)).

panels.label: IT-1M status board
panels.notes: At the vehicle commander's (the squad leader's) place (rwd_mb3: "Tableau IT-1M in PU-12M am Platz des Kommandeurs"; csla_pu12_manual item 4). The plate's legends and lamps are drawn by its display; the buttons, fuse and toggle are fixtures (the crew's entries are the post's own, scenario_runner StatusBoards).

panels.label: R-123M (FuG-1)
panels.notes: The front plate of the R-123M mesh (shell r123_fug1; traced from photographs for the Osa cabin, tools/blender/r123m_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 8) puts it.

panels.label: PAB-2 aiming circle case
panels.notes: The aiming circle's case (SAM3D: the plan doesn't show where it is stowed). Opening it stands for taking the PAB-2 out and setting it up on the ground (nav.pab2).

panels.label: Mast winch
panels.notes: The hand winch on the mast's fixed section (csla_pu12_manual, the mast drawings: the winch, cables and pulleys). Cranking it stands for raising the mast and guying it (mast.raise).

panels.label: IT-45 indicator
panels.notes: The IT-45's face, light grey (rwd_mb3 and shilka_narod photographs: a 45 cm tube behind an amber filter and a grid glass, a strip of knobs over it, the ДХ keypad at its left, the ФР block at its right).

panels.label: ДХ characteristics keypad
panels.notes: The ДХ keypad (csla_pu12_manual item 15; rwd_mb3: Pult DCh, entering a target's number, height zone, characteristics and the designation signal with an address). SAM3D works the digits (the target's number), ЦУ and a digit after it (the launcher's place on the IT boards: he reads it out on the battery net) and СБР (reset). Labels read at low resolution.

panels.label: DT-2 coordinate pickup
panels.notes: The marker's pickup on the desk (rwd_mb3: Geber der Koordinaten DT-2; the ČSLA plan's item 20, DI). SAM3D works it as two wheels: the marker's azimuth and its range.

panels.label: ФР block
panels.notes: The ФР block (shilka_narod photograph: БЛОК ФР, a РАБОТА / КОНТРОЛЬ selector, the scale selector, a power toggle, brightness knobs and a second РАБОТА / КОНТРОЛЬ toggle) at the tube's right. The ASPD-U's power switch is SAM3D's reading of its ВКЛ toggle.

panels.label: S synchronisation block
panels.notes: The S block (csla_pu12_manual item 13; the commander's workplace drawing: the blocks with rows of switches over the tube). Its face is SAM3D's arrangement.

panels.label: R telecode transmitter
panels.notes: On the face of R telecode transmitter (csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 11)).

panels.label: P telecode receiver
panels.notes: On the face of P telecode receiver (csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 34)).

panels.label: RTK-1 radiotelephone concentrator
panels.notes: The RTK-1 (csla_pu12_manual item 16; flak11 PU12-1: field telephone lines and an acoustic signal), as the photograph shows it (shilka_narod) and the NVA catalogue describes it (rwd_mb3): the lines' windows over their levers and lamps, the РСТ lamps, the call buttons, the talk and second-receiver selectors, the headset's jack. Its power switch is SAM3D's.

panels.label: IT-2M status board
panels.notes: At the commander's workplace (rwd_mb3: "Tableau IT-2M ... am Platz des Operators", over the IT-45; csla_pu12_manual item 18). The plate's legends and lamps are drawn by its display; the buttons, fuse and toggle are fixtures (the crew's entries are the post's own, scenario_runner StatusBoards).

panels.label: Air-situation map
panels.notes: The plotter's map board (csla_pu12_manual item 24, planšet vzdušné situace: drawn folded on the centreline before his place; rwd_mb3: the Luftlagekarte, a plexiglass board on a hinge, etched with a grid and range circles), swung open across the compartment facing him. docs/research/PU12_VISUALS_2026-10.md

panels.label: S-23 data transmission set
panels.notes: The S-23 (rwd_mb3: the PU-12M's data transmission set behind the driver, a black box with a row of coloured lamps). What each lamp shows is SAM3D's.

panels.label: ŠČK commander's panel
panels.notes: The commander's panel (ЩК; csla_pu12_manual item 36). What its switches do is not published; SAM3D gives it the lamps of the commander's nets.

panels.label: R-123M (FuG-2)
panels.notes: The front plate of the R-123M mesh (shell r123_fug2; traced from photographs for the Osa cabin, tools/blender/r123m_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 22) puts it.

panels.label: R-407 radio (FuG-5)
panels.notes: A plane of the SM_RadioR407 mesh's front, 3.5 mm out of its plate (traced from photographs: tools/blender/r407_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 25) puts it.

panels.label: R-407: the meter
panels.notes: A plane of the SM_RadioR407 mesh's front, 32.5 mm out of its plate (traced from photographs: tools/blender/r407_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 25) puts it.

panels.label: R-111 radio (FuG-3)
panels.notes: A plane of the SM_RadioR111 mesh's front, 4 mm out of its plate (traced from photographs: tools/blender/r111_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 41) puts it.

panels.label: R-111: the connector strip
panels.notes: A plane of the SM_RadioR111 mesh's front, -13 mm out of its plate (traced from photographs: tools/blender/r111_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 41) puts it.

panels.label: R-111: the scale's eyepiece
panels.notes: A plane of the SM_RadioR111 mesh's front, 46.5 mm out of its plate (traced from photographs: tools/blender/r111_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 41) puts it.

panels.label: R-111 SAU block (antenna distributor)
panels.notes: The R-111's antenna tuner (csla_pu12_manual item 26, under the bench's back, at the commander's place): he sets the antenna distributor for the radio operator (r111_to p. 64: set before work). On the block's inboard end (SAM3D: the plan shows the block from above only), where he can turn round to it.

panels.label: R-123M (FuG-4)
panels.notes: The front plate of the R-123M mesh (shell r123_fug4; traced from photographs for the Osa cabin, tools/blender/r123m_trace.py). The set stands where csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 40) puts it.

panels.label: PVS-1 intercom box
panels.notes: On the face of PVS-1 intercom box (csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 42)).

panels.label: RK-1U junction box
panels.notes: The RK-1U (csla_pu12_manual item 38; rwd_mb3: two five-position rotaries ПЕРЕДАЧА and ПРИЕМ, ВЫКЛ / ...123 / ...111 / ...407 / ПРОВОД, and toggles С-23 / АСПД-У): the ASPD-U's data path.

panels.label: Radio data (радиоданные)
panels.notes: The radio data on the radio operator's table: each net's frequencies by number, the call signs, the changes. The sheet lies on the desk; its content is the scenario's (docs/crew/12_COMMUNICATIONS.md).

panels.label: Talk tables ПТ-1, ПТ-2
panels.notes: The talk tables on the commander's desk, in front of his R-123M (FuG-2), clear of the ДИ block. The sheet lies on the desk; its content is the scenario's (docs/crew/12_COMMUNICATIONS.md).

panels.label: VS-27 rectifier
panels.notes: On the face of VS-27 rectifier (csla_pu12_manual (the equipment plan, item 43)).

panels.label: ŠČR distribution board
panels.notes: The distribution board (ЩР; csla_pu12_manual item 44; the radio operator's drawing: two meters, a switch between them, a plate below).

displays.label: IT-1M status board
displays.source: rwd_mb3 (Informationstableau IT-1: signal groups for the ammunition, the combat activity and the readiness, input buttons, СБРОС; photographs of the IT-1, IT-1M and IT-2M: КОМПЛЕКТ 1, 1/2, 1/4; РАБОТА ГОТОВ, ВИЖУ, ВЫП.; ТЕХ. СОСТОЯНИЕ РПК, БЧ, ШАССИ; rows of amber lamps); csla_pu12_manual item 4
displays.notes: A row per launcher in the order of the battery: its number; КОМПЛЕКТ lit for the share of its missiles left (SAM3D: a full load, half or more, any left); РАБОТА ГОТОВ for ready, ВИЖУ while it engages (target seen), ВЫП. once it has launched; ТЕХ. СОСТОЯНИЕ dark (no faults modelled); the bottom row the support vehicles (dark). docs/research/PU12_VISUALS_2026-10.md

displays.label: IT-45 indicator
displays.source: rwd_mb3 (the IT-45 shows the primary picture and the telecode's data as digits, signs, characteristics and symbols; the ФР block makes the radial-circular sweep and the range marks; the speed vector and the time of arrival; the DT-2 marker); ru_pu12_text (number 00-99, friend or foe, group, height zone H1-H3, speed vector; scales 35, 50, 100 km); shilka_narod, rwd_mb3 (photographs: the amber filter, the grid glass); viko_commons (the same orange glass on a Soviet remote PPI); radiolamp_elt (the radar screens' long yellow and orange afterglows)
displays.notes: Amber long-persistence picture (the filter in the photographs, as the Soviet PPIs'): the sweep turning with the range marks lighting as it passes and fading, the telecode's targets drawn by the character generator (number, zone mark, speed vector, friends barred), the marker, the marked target brightened with its time of arrival; a cabled radar's echoes painted by the sweep under their symbols. Symbols, the sweep's period (10 s) and the afterglow (6 s: the long-afterglow screens of the Soviet tube table, radiolamp_elt) are SAM3D's. docs/research/PU12_VISUALS_2026-10.md

displays.label: ДХ window
displays.source: rwd_mb3 (photograph: a window of blue glass at the top of the ДХ); gost_21829_76 (a warning flashes at 0.5-1 Hz: ЦУ); what it shows is sam3d
displays.notes: The number the keypad is on (typed, or the marker's target), ЦУ flashing once a second while it waits for the launcher's place, the last designation. Blue-green vacuum-fluorescent seven-segment digits with their dark segments faintly showing: SAM3D's reading of the blue window. docs/research/PU12_VISUALS_2026-10.md

displays.label: Air-situation map
displays.source: rwd_mb3 (Luftlagekarte: the targets' tracks drawn by hand in the designation squares, azimuth and range taken off it; the photograph: a plexiglass board with a grid and range circles); data/command/pu12.json (the board's notation: number, height over the code)
displays.notes: The plotter's grease-pencil marks on the etched plexiglass: each target's last marks joined into a track, its number and height over its code; the post at the centre. The grid's spacing and the pencil's colour are SAM3D's. docs/research/PU12_VISUALS_2026-10.md
